name: workflow-lens
description: For Claude Code dynamic workflows. When a Claude session runs a workflow, its subagents work out of sight and the KiroCrew chat shows none of them. Workflow Lens reads what Claude Code writes to disk and shows each phase, which agents are live, what they answered, and the shape the run took.
author: premshay
highlights: Shows the subagents a Claude Code dynamic workflow runs in the background, which the KiroCrew chat never surfaces
Every phase and agent of a run, with live agents marked and finished ones filled or hollow by whether they returned
Names the shape a run took (fan-out, pipeline, barrier, re-attempt and more), each with the evidence behind it
Reads the run's final output and each agent's answer, with structured results drawn as tables
Starts a new workflow in a chosen shape, with your task already in the prompt
